result.summary: The page is largely well-designed, but a few visual issues stand out: a restaurant name is truncated without ellipsis handling in the horizontal carousel, a loading spinner is stuck/overlapping the ramen card image, and the horizontal category filter row appears cut off at the right edge without a clear scroll affordance.

issues.description: In the 'Fastest near you' carousel, the third card's title 'Trattoria Piccol...' is cut off at the screen edge with no ellipsis or fade-out, making it look broken rather than intentionally scrollable.
issues.suggestion: Apply text truncation with an ellipsis (e.g. 'Trattoria Piccol…') or add a right-edge gradient/fade to signal that the row is horizontally scrollable.

issues.description: A circular loading spinner is rendered on top of the Tokumaru Ramen Bar card image, suggesting the image failed to finish loading or the spinner is stuck, which looks visually broken.
issues.suggestion: Ensure the image loads fully and remove the spinner once loaded; add a proper placeholder/skeleton and error fallback so a stalled spinner is never left overlapping content.

issues.description: The category filter chips row ('All', 'Pizza', 'Sushi', 'Burgers', 'Healthy') is clipped at the right edge with a partially visible chip and no scroll indicator, so users may not realize more categories exist.
issues.suggestion: Add a subtle right-edge fade or scroll hint, and ensure consistent horizontal padding so the cut-off chip reads as scrollable content.

issues.description: The promo banner's decorative circle shapes are clipped abruptly at the right edge of the green card, which looks slightly unfinished.
issues.suggestion: Either fully contain the decorative shapes within the banner bounds or intentionally bleed them with consistent rounding to match the card's corner radius.
